688:t_3:106.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「So what I came up with was becoming the reactor myself.」

688:t_3:107.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Then I set my sights on the existence of the $$いがみ合う双子$$, and built the $$ジェニオン$$ as the machine to take it away.」

688:t_3:108.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「And the one I picked as its pilot was Miss $$スズネ$$, you see.」

688:t_3:109.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...That is because the other personality sleeping inside me was one of $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル|lc$$s, isn't it.」

688:t_3:111.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That $$アムブリエル$$... was $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$...」

688:t_3:112.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Exactly. She did not answer even the call of our collective consciousness, and lay half asleep inside $$西条涼音$$.」

688:t_3:113.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The fragmentary memories inside me... Most of them must be hers, from when she was linked to $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$.」

688:t_3:114.en:
$n
「Could it be that the anxiety Miss $$スズネ$$ felt was...」

688:t_3:115.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes... Most likely that was about the future of despair she learned of through $$黒の英知$$...」

688:t_3:116.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And I think that as she came to the surface, I, the part of me that split off from her, was freed from that anxiety.」

688:t_3:117.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I see... So she too was tormented by the future of despair...」

688:t_3:118.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But she loves freedom above all else.」

688:t_3:119.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Even if it was to escape that, even if you are the same person from a parallel world, you cannot make her obey.」

688:t_3:120.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Even so, I thought that if she awakened to the power of $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$, the situation would change.」

688:t_3:121.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「So, well... I sent 'that' along with the $$ジェニオン$$ to serve as an alarm clock.」

688:t_3:122.en:
$n
「You mean... what I touched before I boarded the $$ジェニオン$$...」

688:t_3:123.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「That was a shard of $$黒の英知$$.」

688:t_3:125.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Your $$ブーストアップ$$ ability is the work of that shard.」

688:t_3:126.en:
$$セツコ$$
「So that power of yours, $n, didn't come from a $$スフィア$$ after all...」

688:t_3:127.en:
$$ランド$$
「No wonder it was different from ours.」

688:t_3:128.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「You all know how things went from there.」

688:t_3:129.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「A few unexpected things happened, but actually pulling off $$真化融合$$ is first-rate! First-rate! Very good!」

688:t_3:131.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「So, $n? Having heard all this, did you end up despairing after all?」

688:t_3:132.en:
$n
「There is still hope.」
「There is only despair.」

688:t_3:133.en:
$n
「...Even so, I will not fall into despair...」

688:t_3:134.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Now that's a warrior who has transcended hope and despair! Infinite possibilities beyond even my calculations and expectations!」

688:t_3:137.en:
$$宗介$$
「I had heard the rumors, but the unpleasantness of this man... is intolerable.」

688:t_3:138.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Y-yeah... He's just creepy, no matter how you look at it...」

688:t_3:139.en:
$$テッサ$$
「To think a person like this was hiding inside $c...」

688:t_3:140.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Not thinking of people as people... that's no different from the $$御使い$$s!」

688:t_3:141.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「W-wait! If we just talk, you'll understand!」

688:t_3:142.en:
$$レド$$
「Don't expect anyone to trust a man who secretly planted suggestions akin to mind control.」

688:t_3:143.en:
$$カレン$$
「Representative $$エルガン#pilot$$ is just as bad! Letting a guy like this talk him around!」

688:t_3:144.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I apologize for going ahead without telling you. And for my methods as well.」

688:t_3:145.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Come to think of it, you... were like this back in the $$破界事変$$ too.」

688:t_3:146.en:
$$シモン$$
「If you think anything is allowed as long as the goal is right, you are dead wrong.」

688:t_3:147.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I will make no excuses. But I want you to know this, at least.」

688:t_3:148.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「It is a fact that every one of $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル|lc$$s, myself and $$ジエー・ベイベル$$ included, is working to overthrow the $$御使い$$s.」

688:t_3:149.en:
$n
「The names of $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$'s weapons... and $$スヴェル$$, too... So what you want is the Ragnarok of Norse mythology...」

688:t_3:150.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「That's the occult maniac for you! You really get it!」

688:t_3:151.en:
$$ベック$$
「In short, this guy is after the same thing as me.」

688:t_3:152.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Now I understand. You joined the Galactic Raid Fleet to overthrow the $$御使い$$s.」

688:t_3:153.en:
$$ベック$$
「Yeah... Reading the last chapter of '$$メトロポリス$$' would make even me feel that way.」

688:t_3:154.en:
$$万丈$$
「The book about the end of the world, written by $$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$...」

688:t_3:155.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ベック$$... Where did you read it?」

688:t_3:156.en:
$$ベック$$
「I met Miss $$エンジェル$$ and she showed it to me. And for what it's worth, the edition I read had its last chapter rewritten.」

688:t_3:158.en:
$$ベック$$
「It was a real letdown, too. Believe it or not, it was a blank page.」

688:t_3:159.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see... So that is the future that old man entrusted to us.」

688:t_3:160.en:
$$ベック$$
「Anyway! I have no intention of accepting the existence of a bunch playing god outside the world!」

688:t_3:161.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Your mindset is similar to The Edel's. I can understand, to a degree, even the man who refuses to tolerate any being above himself.」

688:t_3:162.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「If you understand, then everything's OK!」

688:t_3:163.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Before that lofty goal, $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル|lc$$s have become one like this, beyond position, methods and personality.」

688:t_3:165.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I do think you'll need our power in the battles to come, though...」

688:t_3:166.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「The future my late allies entrusted to us... Allow me to fight for it as well.」

688:t_3:172.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「You mean the $$ＡＧ$$ costume?」

688:t_3:175.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah~ putting this on does calm the nerves.」

688:t_3:178.en:
$n
「That was $$ブーストアップ$$ and Jeet Kune Do combined. For now, this squares things for your keeping secrets.」

688:t_3:183.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「This once, I'll bend my principles too.」

688:t_3:184.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$カレン$$... I'll leave my share to you and $$スザク$$.」

688:t_3:129: subject of 真化融合まで果たす left impersonal ('actually pulling off Shinka Fusion')
